text:
marie: Heads-up — I'm about to open a batch of docs moves (core -> platform/docs_v2). Need reviewers + merge order. PRs I'll open in a sec: #4821 (APIs), #4822 (SDK snippets), #4823 (guides). Planning a 2-hour merge window tomorrow 09:00 PT. :calendar:
ollo: Quick ask: can we land redirects before the renames? If we rename first we'll get a ton of 404 noise and CI anchor errors. Put redirect rules in the first PR and mention them in the descr.
ben: FYI docs-ci already flagged broken anchors in a local run for the API PR — example error from the anchor-checker: `Broken anchor: #response-streaming` (shows up on build step `link-checker`).
tia: I can run the full preview & smoke tests during the window. Ping me once PRs are stacked and CI is green. I'll post the deploy-preview link here.
docs-bot: docs-ci check failed for PR #4822 — missing redirect entry in `/docs/_redirects`. See: https://ci.internal/builds/98412 (link).
kevin: My preference: merge order should keep cross-references stable. Suggest: #4821 (APIs) -> #4823 (guides) -> #4822 (SDK). That way guides pick up new API URLs before SDK snippets are updated. +1 from infra side if everyone else OK.
marie: OK locking that order. I'll add a `do-not-merge` label until redirects + anchor tests pass. When CI is green I'll remove label and ping. Also adding a small checklist to each PR template: - redirects added - anchor test passed - preview link included - runtime owners tagged.
ollo: For redirects, we currently support two styles. Docusaurus plugin example (docusaurus.config.js):
```js
module.exports = {
  plugins: [
    [require.resolve('@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects'), {
      redirects: [ { from: '/old/path', to: '/new/path' } ]
    }]
  ]
};
```
Or simple netlify-style `_redirects` line: `/old/path /new/path 301` — either is fine, just be consistent.
ben: Also watch for cross-links in other docs. I did a quick grep: grep -R "(/old/path)" docs/ and found ~12 occurrences that will need updating or redirect covers.
marie: Thanks. I'll prepare a small mapping file and paste into PR #4821 description. Tia — when you run the preview please hit these checks below and paste results here:
- nav loads 
- anchors work (click TOC anchors on moved pages)
- search returns moved pages
- spot-check 5 moved pages for rendering regressions
- link-checker (CI) reports zero broken anchors
tia: Will do. Plan: run preview right after the first PR loses the `do-not-merge` label, then smoke test, then we proceed with PR #4823, re-run preview, then #4822 last. I'll post timestamps + any failures. :+1:
marie: Perfect. I'll also add a short note in the release channel about the brief doclink noise window so platform and support are prepared.
kevin: One more nit — if CI still flickers on the anchor check, we can temporarily bump the anchor-check timeout in `scripts/link-checker.js` to reduce false positives, but prefer fixing the anchors instead of patching checks.
marie: Agreed. Let's avoid changing tests unless we hit flaky infra. I'll open the three PRs now and tag reviewers. Will update this thread with PR links.
